reading.title: A Day by the Sea
reading.text: We spent the weekend in a small town by the sea. In the morning the sea was calm, so we went to swim. After lunch the wind came and the waves became high. My brother watched a surfer ride a big wave. Our room had a beautiful sea view. In the evening we waved goodbye to the fishing boats.

reading.text: Our village is by a long river. A bridge goes over the river, and every morning I cross it to go to school. My father likes to fish in the river on Saturdays.
